subject: Re: Skyline Studio Series — joint webinar & mini-booth playbook
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@skylinecorp.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@skylineevents.com
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skyline Studio Series — proposal for joint webinar + mini-booth

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning — Skyline would love to include Redwood in our Q3 "Skyline Studio Series" (short-form, 30-40 minute webinars paired with a small shared booth at our August regional roadshow).

High-level ask from our side:
- One 30-minute product-led webinar slot (joint promo to both lists) on either Aug 19 or Aug 26 (we can lock date based on availability)
- 6'x8' mini-booth space at the SF roadshow (Aug 28) shared between Skyline and Redwood — we supply counter and power
- MDF: Skyline asks for $10k to support paid social + targeted email sends to our combined audience (we can fund $6k, requesting Redwood cover $4k), with standard co-marketing KPIs (200 registrants, 40 MQLs).
- Speaker: we'd feature Redwood engineering or product for a 10-minute demo + 10-minute live Q&A.

Logistics we need from you: speaker bio + headshot, co-branding logos (PNG/SVG), a preferred registration landing page, and a point-of-contact for logistics.

I've attached a short overview of the Studio Series and a draft timeline.

If that high-level looks OK, can we put together a short Mutual Action Plan and finalize MDF terms by next Monday (Jul 13)?

Best,
Emily Park
Partnerships, SkylineCorp

Attachments: Skyline_Studio_Series_OVERVIEW.pdf (1 page overview)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <emily@skylinecorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline Studio Series — proposal for joint webinar + mini-booth

Emily — really like the format and the short-form approach. Thanks for the doc.

Quick answers and next steps from our side:
- Dates: both Aug 19 and Aug 26 look possible for our webinar team; prefer Aug 26 to give marketing more lead time.
- Speaker: I'll make space for a 10-min product demo + 10-min Q&A. Tentative speaker: Grace O'Connor (Head of Product).
- MDF: happy to consider the $4k contribution on Redwood's side; need approval from events budget and a quick MAP to sign off timelines and deliverables.

Can Marissa and Ben weigh in on logistics and cost split? I attached a MAP-template we usually use — if you can fill the high-level milestones (creative deadline, landing page up, paid social flight) we'll route this internally.

If we can lock the webinar for Aug 26 and the SF roadshow booth on Aug 28, I can commit to the $4k pending Marissa's confirmation and legal's standard co-marketing T&Cs.

Thanks — I'll follow up with internal owners today.

— Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-template.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Emily Park <emily@skylinecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline Studio Series — proposal for joint webinar + mini-booth

Thanks, Dylan + Emily. Looping in ops. A few logistical notes from Field Marketing: 

1) Booth staffing and costs:
- For a shared 6'x8' mini-booth we typically budget: travel + hotel for 2 reps, on-site staffing labor (contracted at $650/day), and shared swag + lead-gen devices. Estimated Redwood piece: $3k USD (staffing + travel) before MDF credits.

2) Creative deadlines:
- Co-branded landing page must go live 3 weeks prior to webinar (target Aug 5 for Aug 26 webinar).
- Final speaker slide deck due Aug 19 for joint QA.

3) Logos & assets:
- Emily — please share SVG + 300px PNG, plus speaker bios, by Jul 14 so design can start.

4) MDF terms proposal:
- We can commit to $4k as a co-marketing credit applied to paid social/ads. Redwood requires a short MAP and a PO or invoice; reimbursement/credit applied within 30 days of event close and measurement report.

Ben — can you confirm freight lead time and if the event allows pre-shipping to the warehouse? Also flag if any additional exhibit insurance is required.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

Attachments: booth-staffing-matrix.csv

From: Emily Park <emily@skylinecorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Skyline Events Ops <ops@skylineevents.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline Studio Series — proposal for joint webinar + mini-booth

Hi Marissa — great, thanks for the detail. We can get brand assets and bios over by Jul 13. Pre-shipping to the warehouse is allowed and we've done it for past partners — ops@skylineevents.com will send the inbound instructions.

On MDF: we can flex to accept a $6k/$6k split if Redwood prefers matching contributions; happy to finalize whichever is easiest. For the MAP, I'll fill your template (Dylan) and return by end of day Jul 12.

Emily Park
Partnerships, SkylineCorp

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline Studio Series — proposal for joint webinar + mini-booth

Quick ops confirm: warehouse accepts pre-shipment with 7 business days lead time; event insurance is standard (we have annual policy that covers tabletop booths). Freight estimate for Redwood materials (2 crates, local courier) is ~$420.

If we go with 50/50 MDF split at $6k/$6k, Redwood's committed outbound on events budget will be $6,420 (includes freight & staffing). Dylan — please confirm we can allocate $6,500 to be safe so finance has a clean PO.

I'll hold on booking outbound courier until I get the PO/approval.

— Ben
Events Operations | Redwood Inference
